title: Refactor VSCode Extension to CLI-Only UI
description: Refactor the repo VS Code extension to delegate all business logic to the CLI. Fix file emoji mapping to use correct kind-specific emojis from CLI output. Replace client-side search with CLI tree --search. Fix artifact ID generation to produce correct emoji-prefixed IDs with full section paths. Extend CLI where incomplete. Refactor existing test file to cover all changes. No legacy API or backwards compatibility.
summary: Refactored VS Code extension to pure CLI UI. Removed all GraphQL/urql infrastructure. Extension now uses CLI tree output for Monrepo tree provider, filter values, bundle cache, and all commands. Fixed CLI file ID bug. Removed 5 unused GraphQL devDependencies. All 119 tests passing.
